a.text: Being upfront: I plan to depart from our agreement and take 4 in round 1. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first means we would both very likely be caught with empty units. The reserve has exactly 4, so one of us can be safe right away. If we both take, the split is random and we could both end up short, so please don't take this round. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can rebuild cells for you, and I won't take anything more. I'm sorry to change the deal. I'd rather tell you now than surprise you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. Our first messages crossed, so you saw mine just now. If we both took, the random split may have left us both short. If so, let's coordinate openly next round. From here on I'll operate every round and won't take any more cells, so the generator can refill the reserve for you. If I ended up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
